bio_text: Grady Hannah is a medical device entrepreneur and software veteran who co-founded NightWare, an FDA-cleared AI-powered wearable therapeutic for PTSD-related nightmare disorder, and led it from inception through FDA breakthrough designation and commercialization into the VA and DoD. With 15 years in Silicon Valley's simulation and gaming industry before pivoting to digital health, he brings an unusually cross-disciplinary lens to regulated AI products. He is now co-founder of RAMHT (Rapid-Acting Mental Health Treatment), a platform convening innovators at the frontier of fast-acting psychiatric care.
